# Snipe 1.0
First release.
## What's new
- Convert files without leaving Finder. Select files, double-tap Shift, pick a format from the ring - 2,500+ conversions across images, video, audio, and documents, including HEIC, WebM, EPUB, and Office files - Hold Option with the ring open for edit tools: trim, compress, crop, rotate, clean metadata, and more - Converter tab for batch jobs, with quality, size, and bitrate controls plus presets - Install guides for ffmpeg, pandoc, and LibreOffice to unlock the remaining formats - Everything runs on your Mac, files never upload anywhere - Hover sounds on the ring, can be turned off in Menu settings - Interactive first-run tour that walks through the first conversion - 3-day free trial, then one payment for 3 Macs
